profiles.summary: The cycle 27 vectors aimed at limb-wise operand handling (15,510 large index and shift vectors and 14,598 edge vectors) return the specified word on the official node and on both nanoreth replicas. Three new scripts that make each unchecked subtraction of getFeeGrowthInside borrow return the reference words on all three endpoints. The replay client source has no release after nb-20261125-2 and still maps both HyperEVM spec ids to Cancun.

deltas.delta: nanoreth master, tag nb-20261125-2 and commit b92ad36 have byte-identical Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock (sha256 prefixes db57f890b46c and e8cc9611370d: revm 43.0.3, revm-interpreter 43.0.2, ruint 1.20.1). Commit f0cad31, which rpc.purroofgroup.com reports, pins revm 29.0.1, revm-interpreter 25.0.3 and ruint 1.16.0. src/evm/spec.rs is identical at all four refs and defines only V1 and V2, both mapped to SpecId::CANCUN. No later tag (nb-20261126, nb-20261125-3 and similar) exists.

OSV lists for ruint only RUSTSEC-2025-0137 and RUSTSEC-2026-0220 and nothing for revm or revm-interpreter. Both ruint advisories were cleared for the HyperEVM replay clients in cycle 17; the newest ruint release is 1.21.1 of 2026-10-23, which no HyperEVM client pins.

profiles.summary: Nothing new. The HyperEVM documentation pages on gas, fees and the two block types are byte-identical to the cycle 26 copies.

In 4,001 blocks after 52,328,897, all 2,627 gas price 0 transactions came from the known system senders and none named the PoolManager. The published action schema of authorizeAqav2Role carries no address field, and the Python SDK has no AQAv2 action.

deltas.delta: Blocks 52,328,898 to 52,332,898 hold 20,526 transactions, 2,627 with gas price 0 from 30 senders: 0x6b9e...0a24 (913), 0xc206...3c00 (601), 0x2000...0000 (601), 0x2222...2222 (155) and 26 token system addresses of the 0x20 prefix. No other sender and no transaction to the PoolManager.

The exchange endpoint page defines authorizeAqav2Role with fields type, token and role only (technical or treasury); the aligned quote assets page says the treasury deployer designates a treasury address and activation is by validator vote, without naming the action that sets the address. hyperliquid-python-sdk master exchange.py and signing.py contain no aqav2 or treasury action. Both docs pages are byte-identical to cycle 26.

cleared.check: L-1143: the borrows of the unchecked subtractions in getFeeGrowthInside (src/libraries/Pool.sol:498-509) and of the fee growth difference in Position.update (src/libraries/Position.sol:91-96), which no mined HyperEVM frame and no reference case had used.
cleared.result: Three scripts built on the pmdiff6 driver run the HyperEVM PoolManager bytecode with state overrides only. Script 1 initialises an upper tick above the price, crosses it downward after fees accrue and adds a position whose lower tick is new, so lower minus upper borrows (line 499-500). Script 2 crosses the upper tick upward and adds the position later, so upper minus lower borrows (line 502-503). Script 3 moves the price into the first position's range, pokes and removes it (line 505-508). The reference interpreter confirms the borrow: the stored feeGrowthInside0LastX128 is 0xffff...37afb9b0b5405f48 and 0xffff...ece60c39aa3cf378. All 87 calls of the three scripts return byte-identical records on the official node, f0cad31 and b92ad36.

cleared.check: Upcoming forks over the next six months: announced or staged HyperEVM upgrades, and what an ordinary account could do on the day after a move to Prague or Osaka rules.
cleared.result: None is announced. The announcements channel up to 20 November 2026 names only HyperCore changes (HIP-3 deployer options, portfolio margin) and a reminder to update nanoreth. The HyperEVM page still states Cancun without blobs. The testnet runs no CLZ, no type 4 transactions and no 0x0b or 0x100 precompile. If Prague or Osaka shipped, src/ would compute nothing differently: no core contract reads tx.origin, EXTCODESIZE, EXTCODEHASH, the block number, timestamp or blob fields, or gasleft (search of src/ outside src/test). EIP-7702 delegation of an EOA would only change who can run code as that EOA, which is the owner's choice. The EIP-7825 cap of 16,777,216 gas per transaction lies above the 976,067 gas of the largest measured exit and above the 3,000,000 gas small block cap that already binds.

leadResults.answer: Both cycle 27 vector sets return the specified words on rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm and on the nanoreth replicas f0cad31 and b92ad36: 15,510 of 15,510 hiword vectors and 14,598 of 14,598 pinned edge vectors on each, with no mismatch and no error.

The exchange endpoint documentation defines authorizeAqav2Role with type, token and role only, so this action names no address. The aligned quote assets page does not name the action that designates the treasury address, and the Python SDK master has no AQAv2 action, so no published check of the target's EVM code was found. No new gas price 0 sender appeared in 4,001 blocks after 52,328,897. F-020 stays operator or issuer level and out of scope.

Cleared for HyperEVM. Three scripts make each subtraction of getFeeGrowthInside borrow (Pool.sol:499-500, 502-503, 505-508), and the stored feeGrowthInside0LastX128 values near 2^256 confirm it. Position.update then subtracts wrapped values (Position.sol:91-96). All 87 calls return the reference words on the official node and both replicas. MegaETH, the other chain the lead lists, is not in this unit.

HyperEVM only, operator level. On rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm, latest, safe and finalized are block 52,332,847, and pending returns null. The block hash matches on both replicas. The OP Stack endpoints are outside this unit.

No Hyperliquid page publishes the producer's admission rule for gas price 0 transactions; the HyperEVM, raw block data and dual block pages are byte-identical to cycle 26. The census of 4,001 more blocks shows only system senders, and cycle 23 found a base fee of at least 100,000,000 wei in every block after genesis, so a user transaction with gas price 0 is invalid.

Nothing new has been published. The announcements channel up to 20 November 2026 only asks nanoreth operators to update for compatibility with hl-node. The official endpoint still answers like revm, and the 30,108 vectors of cycle 27 give the same words on it as on the two replicas.

No PoolManager log appeared between blocks 52,266,494 and 52,332,885, and the PoolManager's code, balance and nonce are unchanged, so no new write by the validator could be compared. The cycle 24 argument stands: receipts and Swap logs fix every word a swap writes, and replicas check receipts.
Follow mode was not run, because there was no PoolManager activity to follow: no log between blocks 52,266,494 and 52,332,885. A replacement lead is recorded.
